hints.tr: Küme farkı tekrarları da atar: `set(running) - set(needed)`; sonra `sorted`.
hints.en: A set difference also drops repeats: `set(running) - set(needed)`; then `sorted`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def extra_services(running, needed):
    return sorted(set(running) - set(needed))

RUNNING = ["web", "telnet", "ssh", "ftp", "telnet"]
NEEDED = ["web", "ssh", "backup"]
print(extra_services(RUNNING, NEEDED))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def extra_services(running, needed):
    return sorted(set(running) - set(needed))

RUNNING = ["web", "telnet", "ssh", "ftp", "telnet"]
NEEDED = ["web", "ssh", "backup"]
print(extra_services(RUNNING, NEEDED))
```
